title: Smartphone PPG with ECG reference and acquisition disturbances

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Person; every recording from one person linked

calibration_burden: No per-person ECG or target calibration. Spectral transforms are fixed within each PPG window; any fusion/shrinkage parameters or flexible scaling are trained on development people only.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.prediction_time: After the complete ten-second PPG segment; simultaneous ECG supplies the target but is never an input. Known recording motion/contact conditions are allowed. No human quality annotation is a predictor.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Few held people and mixed comparator results; no clinical qualification.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.
Resolve each stated measurement/information restriction with source-bound evidence.
Demonstrate a nondegenerate task with grouping adequate for its explicitly claimed transfer; retain limited scope if the present data cannot do this.
